response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced full-stack engineer with roughly 15+ years of hands-on development, open-source contributions, and founder experience, but his profile is that of a strong senior/staff IC rather than a director-level principal engineer driving AI strategy. His AI exposure is recent and narrow (MCP code generators and agent tooling at re:cinq), with no recognized AI thought leadership, advanced AI-related degree, or track record of shipping AI-powered products or advising strategic customers, which are central to this role.
strengths: 15+ years of broad engineering experience across web, mobile, embedded, and high-throughput backend systems
Entrepreneurial track record as founder of GISCollective and multiple open-source projects
Recent hands-on work with AI-agent infrastructure, MCP tooling, and agentic workflows
concerns: No director/principal-level leadership or organization-wide strategic influence demonstrated
Limited depth in AI/ML — no recognized AI expertise, publications, or shipped AI products at scale
Cloud experience is practical (AWS CDK, Kubernetes) but not at the platform-strategy or advisory level required

key_factors.factor: Lack of recognized AI expertise and AI product track record
Seniority gap vs. director-level strategic scope
Long, diverse engineering experience with founder/startup background
